# Evenza Hospitality Services

> India's premier event manpower and hospitality partner. Trained volunteers, hospitality teams, and event crew for weddings, corporate events, and expos across India.

Website: https://evenzaa-sable.vercel.app/
Email: indiaevenza@gmail.com
Primary Contact: +91 91617 10849
Head Office: Choti Chaupad, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

Evenza Hospitality Services is a brand of Shree Ji Company Pvt. Ltd., founded by Shlok Aggarwal with co-founder Stuti Shukla. Headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan, Evenza deploys vetted event manpower pan-India — runners, porters, shadow staff, F&B service, supervisors, and event managers — for weddings, conferences, exhibitions, and live shows.

## Services & Specialisations

- [Event Manpower Jaipur](/event-manpower-jaipur): Trained event staff for events in Jaipur.
- [Hospitality Team Jaipur](/hospitality-team-jaipur): VIP guest relations and luxury event hospitality.
- [Wedding Staff Jaipur](/wedding-staff-jaipur): Destination wedding crew including shadow staff and logistics.
- [Wedding Hospitality Jaipur](/wedding-hospitality-jaipur): Complete wedding hospitality and guest management.
- [Corporate Event Staffing Jaipur](/corporate-event-staffing-jaipur): Personnel for AGMs, dealer meets, and conferences.
- [Event Volunteers Jaipur](/event-volunteers-jaipur): Bilingual volunteers for registration, ushering, and ground support.
- [Exhibition Staff Jaipur](/exhibition-staff-jaipur): Booth hosts, demonstrators, and lead generators for expos.
- [Hospitality Manpower Jaipur](/hospitality-manpower-jaipur): F&B and banquet service staff.
- [Event Staffing Rajasthan](/event-staffing-rajasthan): Statewide event staffing across Rajasthan.
- [Event Manpower Rajasthan](/event-manpower-rajasthan): Pan-Rajasthan event manpower deployment.
- [Manpower Agency Jaipur](/manpower-agency-jaipur): Premier event and hospitality manpower agency in Jaipur.
